title: CRITICAL: re-verify drop-shadow (0471) and gradient (0442) closures with a real visual-oracle run

If drop-shadow still fails, fix it for real: verify compileDocument routes filtered instances through PlaceObject3 (tag 70) and the DROPSHADOWFILTER record layout (16.16 fixed-point distance/angle, RGBA order, passes/flags bits) against the local ruffle clone's filter parser.
